movies.overview: The tender, heartbreaking story of a young man’s struggle to find himself, told across three defining chapters in his life as he experiences the ecstasy, pain, and beauty of falling in love, while grappling with his own sexuality.
movies.title: Moonlight
movies.tagline: This is the story of a lifetime

movies.overview: After his older brother passes away, Lee Chandler is forced to return home to care for his 16-year-old nephew. There he is compelled to deal with a tragic past that separated him from his family and the community where he was born and raised.
movies.title: Manchester by the Sea
movies.tagline: I can't beat it.

movies.overview: Mia, an aspiring actress, serves lattes to movie stars in between auditions and Sebastian, a jazz musician, scrapes by playing cocktail party gigs in dingy bars, but as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile fabric of their love affair, and the dreams they worked so hard to maintain in each other threaten to rip them apart.
movies.title: La La Land
movies.tagline: Here's to the fools who dream.

movies.overview: Taking place after alien crafts land around the world, an expert linguist is recruited by the military to determine whether they come in peace or are a threat.
movies.title: Arrival
movies.tagline: Why are they here?

movies.overview: A divorced dad and his ex-con brother resort to a desperate scheme in order to save their family's farm in West Texas.
movies.title: Hell or High Water
movies.tagline: Blood always follows money.

movies.overview: Convinced that his daughter has forgotten how to laugh, a father shows up unannounced while she's living abroad and bombards her with outrageous jokes.
movies.title: Toni Erdmann
movies.tagline: Life is just passing by...

movies.overview: When Michèle, the CEO of a gaming software company, is attacked in her home by an unknown assailant, she refuses to let it alter her precisely ordered life. She manages crises involving family, all the while becoming engaged in a game of cat and mouse with her stalker.
movies.title: Elle

movies.overview: 1930s Korea, in the period of Japanese occupation, a new girl, Sookee, is hired as a handmaiden to a Japanese heiress, Hideko, who lives a secluded life on a large countryside estate with her domineering Uncle Kouzuki. But the maid has a secret. She is a pickpocket recruited by a swindler posing as a Japanese Count to help him seduce the Lady to steal her fortune.
movies.title: The Handmaiden
movies.tagline: Never did they expect to get into a controversial relationship...

movies.overview: In a dystopian near future, single people, according to the laws of The City, are taken to The Hotel, where they are obliged to find a romantic partner in forty-five days or are transformed into animals and sent off into The Woods.
movies.title: The Lobster
movies.tagline: An unconventional love story...

movies.overview: A week in the life of Paterson, a poet bus driver, and his wife Laura, a very creative artist, who live in Paterson, New Jersey, hometown of many famous poets and artists.
movies.title: Paterson
movies.tagline: Beauty is often found in the smallest details.

movies.overview: A chronicle of the rise and fall of O.J. Simpson, whose high-profile murder trial exposed the extent of American racial tensions, revealing a fractured and divided nation.
movies.title: O.J.: Made in America

movies.overview: An account of the days of First Lady, Jacqueline Kennedy, in the immediate aftermath of John F. Kennedy's assassination in 1963.
movies.title: Jackie

movies.overview: In 1630, a farmer relocates his family to a remote plot of land on the edge of a forest where strange, unsettling things happen. With suspicion and paranoia mounting, each family member's faith, loyalty and love are tested in shocking ways.
movies.title: The Witch
movies.tagline: Evil takes many forms.

movies.overview: Three strong-willed women strive to forge their own paths amidst the wide-open plains of the American Northwest: a lawyer forced to subdue a troubled client; a wife and mother whose plans to construct her dream home reveal fissures in her marriage; and a lonely ranch hand who forms an ambiguous bond with a young law student.
movies.title: Certain Women

movies.overview: A restless teenager escapes her troubled home and joins a traveling crew of young drifters selling magazines across the American Midwest. Immersed in a world of reckless partying, risky hustles, and fleeting romances, she searches for freedom and belonging on the open road.
movies.title: American Honey

movies.overview: A punk rock band is forced to fight for survival after witnessing an act of violence at a skinhead bar.
movies.title: Green Room
movies.tagline: One way in. No way out.

movies.overview: A comedy that follows a group of friends as they navigate their way through the freedoms and responsibilities of unsupervised adulthood.
movies.title: Everybody Wants Some!!
movies.tagline: Here for a good time. Not a long time.

movies.overview: Determined to prove herself, Officer Judy Hopps, the first bunny on Zootopia's police force, jumps at the chance to crack her first case - even if it means partnering with scam-artist fox Nick Wilde to solve the mystery.
movies.title: Zootopia
movies.tagline: Welcome to the urban jungle.

movies.overview: As a visually radical memoir, CAMERAPERSON draws on the remarkable footage that filmmaker Kirsten Johnson has shot and reframes it in ways that illuminate moments and situations that have personally affected her. What emerges is an elegant meditation on the relationship between truth and the camera frame, as Johnson transforms scenes that have been presented on Festival screens as one kind of truth into another kind of story—one about personal journey, craft, and direct human connection.
movies.title: Cameraperson

movies.overview: A boy growing up in Dublin during the 1980s escapes his strained family life by starting a band to impress the mysterious girl he likes.
movies.title: Sing Street
movies.tagline: Boy meets girl. Girl unimpressed. Boy starts band.

movies.overview: From Jane Austen’s novella, the beautiful and cunning Lady Susan Vernon visits the estate of her in-laws to wait out colorful rumors of her dalliances and to find husbands for herself and her daughter. Two young men, handsome Reginald DeCourcy and wealthy Sir James Martin, severely complicate her plans.
movies.title: Love & Friendship
movies.tagline: A lady never reveals her tactics.

movies.overview: In 1958, in the state of Virginia, the idea of interracial marriage was not only considered to be immoral to many, it was also illegal. When Richard and Mildred fall in love, they are aware of the eyes staring at them and the words said behind their backs. It's when they get married, however, that words and looks become actions, and the two are arrested. The couple decide to take their case all of the way to the Supreme Court in order to fight for their love. Based on a true story.
movies.title: Loving
movies.tagline: All love is created equal.

movies.overview: In the 17th century, two Portuguese Jesuit priests travel to Japan in an attempt to locate their mentor, who is rumored to have committed apostasy, and to propagate Catholicism.
movies.title: Silence
movies.tagline: Sometimes silence is the deadliest sound.

movies.overview: In 1979 Santa Barbara, California, Dorothea Fields is a determined single mother in her mid-50s who is raising her adolescent son, Jamie, at a moment brimming with cultural change and rebellion. Dorothea enlists the help of two younger women – Abbie, a free-spirited punk artist living as a boarder in the Fields' home and Julie, a savvy and provocative teenage neighbour – to help with Jamie's upbringing.
movies.title: 20th Century Women

movies.overview: The origin story of former Special Forces operative turned mercenary Wade Wilson, who, after being subjected to a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing powers, adopts the alter ego Deadpool. Armed with his new abilities and a dark, twisted sense of humor, Deadpool hunts down the man who nearly destroyed his life.
movies.title: Deadpool
movies.tagline: Feel the love.

movies.overview: Working from the text of James Baldwin’s unfinished final novel, director Raoul Peck creates a meditation on what it means to be Black in the United States.
movies.title: I Am Not Your Negro

movies.overview: Ricky is a defiant young city kid who finds himself on the run with his cantankerous foster uncle in the wild New Zealand bush. A national manhunt ensues, and the two are forced to put aside their differences and work together to survive.
movies.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
movies.tagline: Nature just got gangster.

movies.original_title: รักที่ขอนแก่น
movies.overview: In a hospital, ten soldiers are being treated for a mysterious sleeping sickness. In a story in which dreams can be experienced by others, and in which goddesses can sit casually with mortals, a nurse learns the reason why the patients will never be cured, and forms a telepathic bond with one of them.
movies.title: Cemetery of Splendor

movies.overview: Susan Morrow receives a book manuscript from her ex-husband – a man she left 20 years earlier – asking for her opinion of his writing. As she reads, she is drawn into the fictional life of Tony Hastings, a mathematics professor whose family vacation turns violent.
movies.title: Nocturnal Animals
movies.tagline: When you love someone you can't just throw it away.

movies.overview: A private eye investigates the apparent suicide of a fading porn star in 1970s Los Angeles and uncovers a conspiracy.
movies.title: The Nice Guys
movies.tagline: They're not that nice.

movies.overview: In 1950s Pittsburgh, a frustrated African-American father struggles with the constraints of poverty, racism, and his own inner demons as he tries to raise a family.
movies.title: Fences
movies.tagline: Some people build fences to keep people out, and other people build fences to keep people in.

movies.overview: Kubo mesmerizes the people in his village with his magical gift for spinning wild tales with origami. When he accidentally summons an evil spirit seeking vengeance, Kubo is forced to go on a quest to solve the mystery of his fallen samurai father and his mystical weaponry, as well as discover his own magical powers.
movies.title: Kubo and the Two Strings
movies.tagline: Be bold. Be brave. Be epic.

movies.overview: An in-depth look at the prison system in the United States and how it reveals the nation's history of racial inequality.
movies.title: 13th
movies.tagline: From slave to criminal with one amendment.

movies.original_title: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
movies.overview: A rogue band of resistance fighters unite for a mission to steal the Death Star plans and bring a new hope to the galaxy.
movies.title: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
movies.tagline: Empires are built on fear. Rebellions are built on hope.

movies.overview: This film is a metaphor for who we are, for where we come from? A secret held in the abyss.  To read the message - through fear and prejudice, from imitation to communion, from meditation to movement. Dance to the horizon - from points of no return.  The irony of our metamorphosis - in order to grow, the seed must die.
movies.title: Aquarius

movies.overview: Following the events of Age of Ultron, the collective governments of the world pass an act designed to regulate all superhuman activity. This polarizes opinion amongst the Avengers, causing two factions to side with Iron Man or Captain America, which causes an epic battle between former allies.
movies.title: Captain America: Civil War
movies.tagline: United we stand. Divided we fall.

movies.overview: Nathalie teaches philosophy at a high school in Paris. She is passionate about her job and particularly enjoys passing on the pleasure of thinking. Married with two children, she divides her time between her family, former students and her very possessive mother. One day, Nathalie’s husband announces he is leaving her for another woman. With freedom thrust upon her, Nathalie must reinvent her life.
movies.title: Things to Come

movies.overview: On 15 January 2009, the world witnessed the 'Miracle on the Hudson' when Captain 'Sully' Sullenberger glided his disabled plane onto the Hudson River, saving the lives of all 155 souls aboard. However, even as Sully was being heralded by the public and the media for his unprecedented feat of aviation skill, an investigation was unfolding that threatened to destroy his reputation and career.
movies.title: Sully
movies.tagline: The untold story behind the miracle on the Hudson.

movies.overview: Documentary featuring a jaw-dropping, behind-the-scenes look at the attempted comeback of Anthony Weiner in 2013 as he mounts a campaign for New York City mayor in the wake of his sexting scandal. Featuring unfettered access to the candidate and his campaign.
movies.title: Weiner

movies.overview: While training at the gym, 11-year-old tomboy Toni becomes entranced with a dance troupe. As she struggles to fit in, she finds herself caught up in danger as the group begins to suffer from fainting spells and other violent fits.
movies.title: The Fits
movies.tagline: Why fit in when you can dance to your own beat?

movies.overview: When a Hollywood star mysteriously disappears in the middle of filming, the studio sends their fixer to get him back.
movies.title: Hail, Caesar!
movies.tagline: Lights. Camera. Abduction.

movies.overview: Two high school girls are best friends until one dates the other's older brother, who is totally his sister's nemesis.
movies.title: The Edge of Seventeen
movies.tagline: You're only young once… is it over yet?

movies.overview: WWII American Army Medic Desmond T. Doss, who served during the Battle of Okinawa, refuses to kill people and becomes the first Conscientious Objector in American history to receive the Congressional Medal of Honor.
movies.title: Hacksaw Ridge
movies.tagline: One of the greatest heroes in American history never fired a bullet.

movies.overview: When aspiring model Jesse moves to Los Angeles, her youth and vitality are devoured by a group of beauty-obsessed women who will take any means necessary to get what she has.
movies.title: The Neon Demon
movies.tagline: Beauty is vicious.

movies.overview: A father and son go on the run after the dad learns his child possesses special powers.
movies.title: Midnight Special
movies.tagline: He's not like us.

movies.overview: After a catastrophic car crash, a young woman wakes up in a survivalist's underground bunker, where he claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack that has left the outside world uninhabitable.
movies.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
movies.tagline: Monsters come in many forms.

movies.overview: A middle aged carpenter, who requires state welfare after injuring himself, is joined by a single mother in a similar scenario.
movies.title: I, Daniel Blake
movies.tagline: My name is Daniel Blake. I am a man, not a dog.

movies.overview: When Krisha returns to her estranged family for Thanksgiving dinner, past demons threaten to ruin the festivities.
movies.title: Krisha

movies.overview: Documentary about humans dealing with changing technology, the basic concepts of communication, cinema, and Akerman's mother, seen in her Brussels apartment.
movies.title: No Home Movie

movies.overview: By mistake, film director Ham Chunsu arrives in Suwon a day early. With time to kill before his lecture the next day, Chunsu stops by a restored, old palace and meets an artist named Yoon Heejung. Together, they go to Heejung's workshop to look at her paintings, have Sushi with Soju for dinner, and get close. Later, they go to another café and have more drinks with Heejung's acquaintances. When asked if he is married, Chunsu is forced to reveal the fact that he is, and Heejung gets deeply disappointed...
movies.title: Right Now, Wrong Then
